title: Specify client-registry matching quality, adjudication and equity
requirements:
- Define matching thresholds, confidence representation and minimum operational controls for linking and deduplication
- Require context-specific thresholds for false and missed matches with representative and subgroup evaluation
- Require validation, versioning and governance approval of custom matching algorithms
- Require localised, culturally appropriate matching rules, explainable match evidence and human adjudication
- Make authorised adjudication mandatory below threshold or for high-consequence matches
- Require ongoing monitoring and recalibration
- Restrict demographic candidate searches (minimum criteria, result limits, masking, audit)
- Note: these comments are anchored to 5.4.1 but concern the client registry requirements
